claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $392.4 million, up 27% sequentially and 104% year over year; six-month revenue was $700.761 million versus $351.367 million in the prior-year period.
At June 30, 2026 Astera Labs held $111.453 million cash and $1.142 billion marketable securities, providing substantial liquidity against near-term operating and product-ramp needs.

Accounts receivable increased to $192.469 million from $83.202 million at 2025 year-end and inventory increased to $113.781 million from $58.979 million, creating a concrete cash-conversion/sell-through watch item during rapid growth.

Management expected Scorpio X-Series to become the largest product family in Q3 2026, one quarter ahead of prior expectations; this is a measurable near-term execution catalyst but remains forward-looking until subsequent filed results.

The September 2026 Leo expansion broadens the addressable memory-connectivity problem set, but sampling/design-win language does not establish production revenue, durable pricing power or customer diversification.
